item.title: "I Feared Defeat More Than Death"... The Confession of Korea's First Four-Star General (“죽음보다 패전이 두려웠다”… 대한민국 최초 ‘4스타’ 장군의 고백)
item.description:
"I Feared Defeat More Than Death"... The Confession of Korea's First Four-Star General (“죽음보다 패전이 두려웠다”… 대한민국 최초 ‘4스타’ 장군의 고백)

At the former site of Seoul National University's College of Liberal Arts and Sciences in Dongsung-dong, Seoul, where the U.S. Eighth Army headquarters was located, then-U.S. President-elect Dwight Eisenhower eventually visited Gyeongmudae. This was the result of persuading Mark Clark, the United Nations Commander in Tokyo, who accompanied Eisenhower on his visit to Seoul. Following Clark's directive to "return to Gyeongmudae and wait," Army Chief of Staff Paik Sun-yup immediately got into a jeep and headed back to Gyeongmudae. President Syngman Rhee, who was eagerly hoping for his arrival, began preparations to welcome Eisenhower as soon as he heard Clark's words. Paik first inspected the military band stationed in the Gyeongmudae courtyard. <<> Around 6 o'clock, Eisenhower and his party arrived at Gyeongmudae. Eisenhower brought along his son, Major John Eisenhower, who was then serving in the war. The entourage included Clark, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Bradley, and the entire delegation visiting Korea. Eisenhower's party first held a brief honor guard review in the Gyeongmudae courtyard. They then moved to the reception room at Gyeongmudae and had a friendly conversation with President Syngman Rhee. With Eisenhower's son present, the atmosphere of the discussion was reportedly warm. <<> What if Eisenhower's visit to Gyeongmudae had ultimately fallen through? The relationship between the proud President Rhee and the U.S. administration could have become very strained. Many hurdles remained until the armistice was signed on July 27, 1953. If Eisenhower's failure to visit Gyeongmudae had further soured relations between the two governments, overcoming the numerous challenges ahead would have been much more difficult. <<> Paik Sun-yup's style, as revealed in resolving issues like Eisenhower's visit to Korea and subsequent friction with President Rhee, can be seen as highly multifaceted. He was generally known for his gentle demeanor. This was evident in his later years, long after the war ended. He showed utmost respect to everyone, regardless of age, and rarely changed his expression over trivial matters. His gentle expression and reluctance to boast about his exploits led some to ask, "Is that really our country's first four-star general?" <<> Paik Sun-yup himself said, "I tried to avoid quarreling with others over small matters as much as possible." He steered clear of verbal disputes and empty debates. When asked, "Weren't you afraid on the battlefield where life and death intersect?" he replied, "As a human, why wouldn't I have been afraid?" He added, "Nevertheless, as a soldier, I was prepared to risk my life when necessary." <<> Though undoubtedly a renowned commander, Paik Sun-yup was not the reckless type who would rush into battle without hesitation. This means that while courage is valuable on the battlefield where lives are at stake, he was not someone who decided outcomes based on that single virtue alone. He also seemed somewhat lacking in being called a wise general. He showed little interest in defeating opponents through strategy alone. This wasn't because he was the type to be overwhelmed by the enemy's momentum while solely focusing on finding methods and then retreating. Could he then be called a virtuous general? <<> His attitude toward subordinates was gentle and soft, but it didn't quite fit to label him solely as a virtuous general. To defeat the enemy, he was also a commander who, in the early morning, walked through frontline trenches, endlessly encouraging and urging his soldiers. Moreover, he was a commander who shunned the command room to avoid missing the battle situation, instead staying in the radio room, where the front-line updates came in directly, fighting off drowsiness. He was also not a virtuous general whose resolve could falter due to a tender heart before the enemy, overly concerned about conserving his troops. <<> Paik Sun-yup was a commander deeply immersed in war. Though his expression was gentle, it contained the determination he often spoke of: "I was not afraid of death, but I truly feared defeat." Thus, outwardly unassuming, inwardly he could be seen as a fierce competitor, gritting his teeth to defeat the opponent with a heart that felt like it was rotting away. With such qualities, he led the victory in the crucial battle for the nation—the Battle of Dabudong in Chilgok, Gyeongbuk. Driving through the arduous path of the northward advance, he led the significantly inferior 1st Division of the ROK Army in mobility and organization at the time to reach Pyongyang ahead of the U.S. 1st Cavalry Division. <<> He then showed bold decisiveness by ordering a retreat during a meeting engagement with Chinese forces, and as the vanguard of the ROK Army in recapturing Seoul from the Chinese, as the 1st Corps commander, he advanced the front northward. He served as the ROK's first armistice negotiation representative, succeeded in cleansing guerrilla forces around Jirisan, and took the first steps in modernizing the ROK Army through the re-establishment of the 2nd Corps, achieving numerous combat feats and accomplishments. The U.S. military often praised him, calling him "the most skillful leader" (as stated in a congratulatory letter from U.S. 1st Corps Commander Frank Milburn in April 1951 for Paik's promotion to 1st Corps commander). With such a record, Paik Sun-yup, at the age of 32, served as the Chief of Staff of the ROK Army. <<> This same Paik Sun-yup succeeded in turning around Eisenhower, who visited Korea as a president-elect but strenuously avoided visiting Gyeongmudae. He did this by resorting to a statement bordering on a threat: "How does the U.S. intend to manage an ROK military that will soon grow into a force of a million?" Through such deep contemplation and tenacious effort, he was soon to become Korea's first four-star general, with stars on his shoulders and forehead. <<> Eisenhower and his party safely began their return journey. The visit to Gyeongmudae took place, and in a harmonious atmosphere, Syngman Rhee and Eisenhower conversed. After they left, Paik Sun-yup was once again buried in his busy schedule, and accompanied President Rhee on his visit to Japan, arranged by Clark. U.S. military trust in Paik Sun-yup grew daily. However, Van Fleet, the commander of the U.S. Eighth Army, who had astonishingly devoted himself to strengthening the ROK military in less than two years since his arrival on the Korean front, was soon to depart. <<> Maxwell Taylor, who had led the initial assault in the Normandy landings, was about to take command of the new U.S. Eighth Army. As Van Fleet, who had diligently aided Korea, stepped down, the situation could face considerable changes. Then, one day, as Paik Sun-yup sat in his office at the ROK Army headquarters in Daegu, he saw his secretaries preparing something outside his office door. Soon, a message arrived from the temporary Gyeongmudae in Busan. It said, "Report to Gyeongmudae." <<>> (서울 동숭동 옛 서울대 문리대 자리에 있던 미8군 사령부에서 드와이트 아이젠하워 당시 미 대통령 차기 당선자는 결국 경무대를 예방했다. 아이젠하워 당선자를 수행해 서울에 함께 왔던 도쿄 주재 유엔군 총사령관 마크 클라크를 설득한 결과였다. “경무대로 돌아가 기다려라”고 했던 클라크의 언질에 따라 백선엽 육군 참모총장은 곧장 지프에 올라타 경무대로 돌아왔다. 그가 오길 간절히 기대하고 있던 이승만 대통령은 클라크의 발언을 전하자 곧장 아이젠하워를 맞이할 준비에 들어갔다. 백선엽은 경무대 뜰에 있던 군악대를 우선 점검했다.)

item.title: Victor Cha’s ‘Cold Peace’ Proposal Draws Backlash… “Risks Hot Danger for South Korea” (빅터 차 ‘차가운 평화’ 주장에 반박 잇달아… “한국엔 뜨거운 위험 초래”)
item.description:
Victor Cha’s ‘Cold Peace’ Proposal Draws Backlash… “Risks Hot Danger for South Korea” (빅터 차 ‘차가운 평화’ 주장에 반박 잇달아… “한국엔 뜨거운 위험 초래”)

Victor Cha, a leading Korea expert at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) in Washington, D.C., has asserted that “denuclearization of North Korea has become a goal difficult to achieve in a short time” and argued that the U.S. should pursue a “cold peace” with North Korea. However, counterarguments have emerged that such a compromise could undermine trust in the U.S.-South Korea alliance, heighten regional nuclear anxiety, and ultimately harm U.S. national interests. Cha, who was involved in U.S.-North Korea negotiations during the George W. Bush administration and was once a hardliner on North Korea within U.S. political circles, caused significant stir in diplomatic circles with an April article in the foreign and security policy journal *Foreign Affairs*, where he acknowledged North Korea’s “nuclear possession” and called for starting dialogue with the North on disarmament and nuclear non-proliferation. CSIS’s Korea program receives support from the Korea Foundation (KF), an agency under the South Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs. (워싱턴 DC의 대표적인 한반도 전문가인 빅터 차 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS) 한국 석좌가 “북한 비핵화는 단시일 내 달성이 어려운 목표가 됐다”며 미국이 북한과의 ‘차가운 평화(cold peace)’를 추구해야 한다고 주장한 가운데, 이런 타협이 한미 동맹 간 신뢰를 훼손하고 지역 내 핵에 대한 불안을 고조시켜 궁극적으로 미국의 국익에 해가 될 것이란 반론이 제기됐다. 조지 W. 부시 정부 때 미·북 협상에 관여한 차 석좌는 미 조야(朝野)의 대북 강경론자였지만 지난 4월 외교·안보 전문지 ‘포린 어페어스’ 기고에서 북한의 ‘핵 보유’ 현실을 인정하고 군축·핵무기 비확산을 위한 미·북 대화를 시작해야 한다는 취지로 주장해 외교가에서 파장이 적지 않았다. CSIS의 한반도 연구 프로그램은 외교부 산하 기관인 한국국제교류재단(KF)의 지원을 받고 있다.)

Lee Shin-wha, a professor of political science and international relations at Korea University who is a multilateral expert and former ambassador for international cooperation on North Korean human rights at the South Korean Foreign Ministry, wrote in the June issue of *Foreign Affairs* that “North Korea has deeply embedded nuclear expansion into its constitution and operational plans, so Washington can no longer expect short-term denuclearization.” However, she argued that Cha’s “cold peace” could pose a “hot risk” to South Korea. If the U.S. prioritizes its own security over South Korea’s vulnerabilities in dialogue with North Korea, “Pyongyang could exploit that rift to test deterrence through ‘gray zone’ coercion against Seoul, such as cyber operations.” She added, “Easing pressure on the North while neglecting issues like regime repression and forced labor would only further entrench the Kim Jong Un regime. The U.S. must avoid shifting risks onto Seoul.” (다자(多者) 분야 전문가면서 외교부 북한인권국제협력대사를 지낸 이신화 고려대 정치외교학과 교수는 6월 포린 어페어스에서 “북한이 핵 확장을 헌법, 작전 계획에 깊이 뿌리를 내려 워싱턴(미국)이 더 이상 단기적 비핵화를 기대할 수 없게 됐다”면서도 차 석좌의 ‘차가운 평화’론이 한국에는 ‘뜨거운 위험(hot risk)’을 초래할 수 있다고 했다. 미국이 북한과의 대화에서 한국이 갖는 취약성보다 자국 안보를 우선시하게 되면 “북한이 그 분열을 악용해 한국을 대상으로 사이버 작전 같은 ‘회색 지대’ 강압을 통해 억지력을 시험할 수 있다”는 것이다. 또 “정권의 탄압, 강제 노동 같은 문제를 방치한 채 대북 압박을 완화하면 김정은 정권을 더 공고히 할 뿐”이라며 “미국이 서울로 위험을 전가하는 일은 피해야 한다”고 했다.)

Nicholas Eberstadt, a senior fellow at the American Enterprise Institute (AEI), and David Maxwell, vice chairman of the Center for Asia-Pacific Strategy (CAPS), argued, “North Korea’s nuclear and missile capabilities are far more advanced today than 30 years ago when the first negotiations took place. The policies Cha proposes cannot reverse this trend because the North Korean regime believes that the division of the Korean Peninsula and nuclear weapons guarantee its survival.” They added, “A free and unified Korea is the only sustainable path to peace, human rights, and the elimination of the nuclear threat on the peninsula. While conventional wisdom holds that unification is impossible and prohibitively costly, making it the strategic end goal of U.S.-South Korea policy is both feasible and essential for national security.” They asserted, “A democratic, non-nuclear, and economically unified Korea would align with the long-term strategic interests of the U.S., South Korea, and America’s allies in Asia.” (니콜라스 에버스타트 미국기업연구소(AEI) 선임연구원과 데이비드 맥스웰 아시아태평양전략센터(CAPS) 부회장은 “북한의 핵·미사일 능력은 첫 협상이 이뤄졌던 30년 전보다 오늘날 훨씬 더 발전해 있다”며 “차 석좌가 주장하는 정책들은 이런 흐름을 되돌릴 수 없다. 북한 정권은 한반도 분단, 핵이 정권의 생존을 보장한다고 믿기 때문”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “자유롭고 통일된 한국이야말로 한반도의 평화, 인권, 그리고 핵 위협을 제거할 수 있는 유일한 지속 가능한 길”이라며 “통념상 통일은 실현 불가능하고 감당하기 어려울 정도로 막대한 비용이 소요될 것이라 여겨지지만 통일을 한미 정책의 전략적 최종 목표로 삼는 것은 실현 가능하고 국가 안보에 필수적인 일”이라고 했다. 이들은 “민주적이고 핵무기가 없으며 경제적으로 통일된 한국은 한미와 아시아 내 미 동맹국의 장기적 전략 이익에 부합할 것”이라 주장했다.)

In response to these critiques, Cha stated, “While some point out that ‘cold peace’ could neglect South Korea’s interests, reducing the threat of North Korean ICBMs to the U.S. homeland would prevent Pyongyang from holding American cities hostage in a crisis, thereby strengthening South Korea’s security.” He also argued that even if the U.S. reduces ground forces on the Korean Peninsula, the most crucial element of deterrence—direct U.S. intervention in a conflict—would remain intact. “If North Korea attacks, Americans will still be on the front lines, facing gunfire,” he said. Cha described his proposed “cold peace” as “an interim solution to address the rapidly escalating North Korean nuclear threat,” adding, “Obsessing over denuclearization or insisting on unification will neither deter North Korea’s nuclear weapons nor ensure the safety of the U.S. or its allies.” (이런 반론에 대해 차 석좌는 “‘차가운 평화’가 한국의 이익을 소홀히 할 수 있다고 지적하지만 미 본토에 대한 북한 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM)의 위협을 줄이면 평양이 (유사시) 미국 도시들을 인질로 삼을 수 없어 한국의 안보를 강화하는 것”이라고 했다. 또 한반도 내 미 지상군 병력 감축이 이뤄지더라도 억지력의 가장 중요한 요소인 유사시 ‘직접 개입’은 유지된다며 “북한이 공격할 경우 미국인들은 여전히 총탄이 빗발치는 전선에 서게 될 것”이라고 했다. 차 석좌는 자신이 주장한 ‘차가운 평화’가 “급속히 확산하고 있는 북한의 핵 위협에 대처하기 위한 과도기적인 해결책”이라며 “비핵화에 집착하거나 통일을 주장하는 것은 북한의 핵을 저지하지도, 미국이나 동맹국의 안전을 보장하지도 못한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee and Moon to Meet Ahead of Party Convention… Luncheon at the Blue House on July 1 (전대 앞두고 李·文 만난다… 내달 1일 靑 오찬)
item.description:
Lee and Moon to Meet Ahead of Party Convention… Luncheon at the Blue House on July 1 (전대 앞두고 李·文 만난다… 내달 1일 靑 오찬)

The Blue House announced on the 25th that President Lee Jae-myung will have a luncheon with former President Moon Jae-in at the Blue House on July 1. This marks the first solo meeting between President Lee and former President Moon since Lee took office. Blue House Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung stated in a briefing, "They are meeting with an open agenda," adding, "They are expected to have a candid exchange of views on overall state affairs and the international situation." (이재명 대통령이 오는 7월 1일 청와대에서 문재인 전 대통령과 오찬을 한다고 청와대가 25일 밝혔다. 이 대통령이 취임 후 문 전 대통령과 단독 회동하는 것은 처음이다. 청와대 강유정 수석대변인은 브리핑에서 “(두 사람이) 열린 주제로 만나는 것”이라며 “국정 현안 전반과 국제 정세 관련해서 허심탄회하게 의견을 나눌 것으로 예상된다”고 했다.)

This meeting was arranged amid escalating conflict between the pro-Lee and pro-Moon factions ahead of the Democratic Party's convention to elect a new party leader in August. Recently, the pro-Lee and pro-Moon discord has intensified, spreading into a confrontation between the new mainstream 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction—supporting President Lee from around the last presidential election—and the old mainstream 'pro-Roh, pro-Moon' faction, deepening the rift within the ruling bloc. After former leader Jung Cheong-rae resigned his post and formally declared his bid for re-election the previous day, his meeting with former President Moon drew complaints from the pro-Lee camp, with some saying, "Isn't this a blatant expression of intent to rally the pro-Roh and pro-Moon forces and win?" (이번 만남은 오는 8월 민주당 당대표를 뽑는 전당대회를 앞두고 친명·친청 갈등이 격화하는 상황에서 성사됐다. 최근 친명·친청 갈등은 지난 대선 전후로 이 대통령을 지지하는 신주류 ‘뉴이재명’과 구주류 ‘친노·친문' 세력 간 대결로 번지면서 여권 분열이 심화되는 양상이었다. 전날 정청래 전 대표가 당대표직을 사퇴하며 연임 도전을 공식화한 뒤 문 전 대통령과 만난 것을 두고도 친명계에선 “친노·친문 세력을 결집해 이기겠다는 노골적 의지 표명 아니냐”는 불만이 나왔다.)

Following this, the Blue House's sudden scheduling of a luncheon with former President Moon has sparked various interpretations. It is said that the Blue House first proposed the meeting to Moon's side, and Moon accepted. A source within the ruling bloc commented, "While there may be an intention to resolve divisions within the support base, it could also be President Lee's way of supporting Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as a candidate for party leadership while keeping Jung in check." Pro-Moon key figure, Democratic Party lawmaker Yoon Gun-young, said on radio that day, "Former President Moon believes that for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the party should resolve matters through unity and wisdom," adding, "In order to eliminate various rumors and misunderstandings, he intends to postpone all meetings with party leadership candidates until after the convention." (이후 청와대가 갑자기 문 전 대통령과의 오찬 일정을 잡자 여러 해석이 나왔다. 이 일정은 청와대가 문 전 대통령 측에 먼저 요청했고 문 전 대통령이 수락했다고 한다. 여권 관계자는 “지지층 분열을 해소하고자 하는 취지도 있겠으나, 이 대통령이 당권주자로 김민석 국무총리를 지원하고 정 전 대표를 견제하는 측면도 있지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 친문 핵심 윤건영 민주당 의원은 이날 라디오에서 “문 전 대통령은 이재명 정부의 성공을 위해 당이 통합과 단결 그리고 슬기롭게 해결했으면 좋겠다는 생각을 갖고 있다”며 “이런저런 설왕설래나 오해를 없앤다는 차원에서 당권 주자들과의 만남은 전당대회 이후로 다 미루려고 한다”고 했다.)

Meetings between President Lee and former President Moon have mostly occurred amid deepening divisions within the ruling bloc. When Lee was the Democratic Party leader in February 2024, ahead of the 22nd general election and as the 'anti-Lee's arbitrary purges' conflict grew, he visited former President Moon at Pyeongsan Village. In January 2025, during the presidential primary phase, as criticism of his one-person leadership intensified mainly from the anti-Lee faction, he again visited Pyeongsan Village. After taking office, he invited former President Moon and his wife to his inauguration—the National Appointment Ceremony—and met them at the 17th anniversary memorial service for the late former President Roh Moo-hyun on May 23, but this is the first time they are having a separate official meeting. (이 대통령과 문 전 대통령의 회동은 대부분 여권 내 분열이 심해지는 상황에서 이뤄졌다. 이 대통령은 민주당 대표 시절인 2024년 2월 22대 총선을 앞두고 ‘비명횡사’ 갈등이 커지자, 평산마을에서 문 전 대통령을 만났다. 2025년 1월 대선 경선 국면에서는 비명계를 중심으로 자신의 일극 체제에 대한 비판이 커지자 평산마을을 찾았다. 취임 후엔 취임식인 국민임명식에 문 전 대통령 부부를 초대했고, 지난달 23일 고(故) 노무현 전 대통령 서거 17주기 추도식에서 만난 적 있으나 별도의 공식 회동을 갖는 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

The Blue House reported that former President Moon's wife, Kim Jung-sook, will not attend due to overseas schedules. Consequently, President Lee's wife, Kim Hye-kyung, will also not be present at the luncheon. (문 전 대통령 부인 김정숙 여사는 해외 일정으로 인해 불참한다고 청와대는 전했다. 이에 따라 이 대통령 부인 김혜경 여사 역시 오찬에 참석하지 않는다.)

item.title: As Opposition Party Convention Approaches… Kim Min-seok Says "Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers Is Government's Position" (與 전당대회 다가오자… 김민석 “보완수사권 폐지가 정부 입장”)
item.description:
As Opposition Party Convention Approaches… Kim Min-seok Says "Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers Is Government's Position" (與 전당대회 다가오자… 김민석 “보완수사권 폐지가 정부 입장”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok announced on the 25th that the government has finalized its basic stance as completely abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers without exceptions. He also stated that the government will not submit its own bill regarding the abolition of supplementary investigation powers to the National Assembly, leaving the matter to the legislature's discussion. With the August party convention to elect the next leadership of the Democratic Party approaching, hardliners like former party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, who is seeking re-election, have gained momentum with their "complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers" argument, leading the government to scrap internal discussions and follow the will of its staunch supporters. The People Power Party criticized, saying, "Is the race for party leadership more important than South Korea's criminal justice system? The Democratic Party is now running wild, looking only for the cheers of its hardcore supporters, not the people of South Korea." <<> At a press conference held at the Seoul Government Complex, Prime Minister Kim stated, "Considering the various opinions discussed and heard by the government, we have finalized the abolition of supplementary investigation powers as the government's basic position." He added, "The fundamental principle of prosecutorial reform promoted by President Lee Jae-myung's administration is the separation of investigation and prosecution. We will convey the government's basic position to the party, and thereafter, rather than the government proposing separate legislation, we will respect the discussions and decisions of the National Assembly." <<> The government established a Prosecutorial Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office in October of last year and has been discussing revisions to the Criminal Procedure Act, including whether to retain the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. The task force had nearly completed a draft of the government's proposal based on numerous public hearings and forums. However, with Prime Minister Kim's announcement that the government would not submit a separate bill to the National Assembly, the task force's discussions have effectively been nullified. It has been reported that neither the task force, the Ministry of Justice, nor the Supreme Prosecutors' Office were informed in advance of Kim's announcement. <<> There are interpretations that Kim's decision to hold an emergency press conference and announce the abolition of supplementary investigation powers is not unrelated to the competition for party leadership within the Democratic Party. President Lee had previously emphasized the need for exceptional supplementary investigation powers, stating, "Blocking even very exceptional cases could cause problems later." Similarly, Prime Minister Kim, during a press conference on the 22nd, had said, "A complete abolition is correct," while adding, "I fully understand President Lee's intentions," and called for deliberation. That Kim announced the "complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers" just three days later is seen as an intention not to fall behind in the race for clarity against former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, who has been emphasizing "full abolition of supplementary investigation powers" day after day. <<> It has been reported that Prime Minister Kim also discussed the press conference with President Lee. Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong said on the same day, "The prime minister's statement can be taken as a clarification of the government's position." The People Power Party commented, "What the government chose was neither the public's rights nor the stability of the criminal justice system. What it ultimately chose was the hardline stance of former leader Jeong, backed by his hardcore supporters." <<> Prime Minister Kim and former leader Jeong were also at odds that day. During the press conference, Kim attributed the delay in discussing the abolition of supplementary investigation powers to the opposition party's demands, saying, "We initially tried to expedite it and handle it in May, but it was postponed due to requests from the party ahead of local elections." In response, former leader Jeong shot back on Facebook, saying, "Not submitting the government bill? It makes one wonder if they've been wasting time for a year. I earnestly hope it's not some stalling tactic." He also called for completing legislation to abolish supplementary investigation powers before Constitution Day. <<> Within the legal community, there are criticisms that "the issue of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, which has a significant impact on people's lives, has become a sacrificial lamb in the fight for party leadership without proper deliberation." There are concerns that abolishing supplementary investigation powers without an alternative could worsen delays in investigations and eliminate the prosecution's ability to check police's inadequate investigations. A current senior prosecutor stated, "It's common sense among those experienced in investigation and trial practice that eliminating the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers would make it impossible to oversee the police's initial investigations." A lawyer who previously served as a deputy chief prosecutor also said, "Since the adjustment of investigative powers between the prosecution and police in 2021, case processing has been delayed, causing dissatisfaction among both crime victims and suspects. If even the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers are removed, the criminal justice system will not just face chaos but collapse." <<> According to the Ministry of Justice and the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, among 55,174 cases received by 12 prosecutors' offices nationwide in March and April, 45.59% (25,152 cases) involved supplementary investigations by the prosecution. These include cases such as a group sexual assault case that the police had decided not to forward to the prosecution, where the prosecution conducted supplementary investigations and detained the main perpetrator, and a case at a residential facility for severely disabled individuals where the prosecution identified additional rape offenses by the facility head. (김민석 국무총리는 검찰 보완수사권을 예외를 두지 않고 완전히 폐지하는 것을 정부의 기본 입장으로 정리했다고 25일 밝혔다. 또 보완수사권 폐지와 관련한 정부안을 국회에 제출하지 않고, 관련 논의를 국회에 일임하기로 했다. 민주당 차기 지도부를 뽑는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 당대표 연임에 나서는 정청래 전 대표 등 강경파의 “보완수사권 완전 폐지” 주장이 힘을 얻자, 그간 정부 차원에서 이뤄진 논의를 폐기하고 강성 지지층 뜻에 따르겠다는 것이다. 국민의힘은 “당권 경쟁이 대한민국 형사사법 체계보다 더 중요한가”라며 “지금 민주당은 대한민국 국민이 아니라 ‘개딸’ 환호만 바라보며 폭주하고 있다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Chung Cheong-rae Head to 'Ruling Party Stronghold' North Jeolla (김민석·정청래 나란히 ‘與 텃밭’ 전북으로)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok and Chung Cheong-rae Head to 'Ruling Party Stronghold' North Jeolla (김민석·정청래 나란히 ‘與 텃밭’ 전북으로)

Kim Min-seok, Prime Minister and a contender for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, along with former Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae, visited the Honam region on the 25th. Honam is home to about one-third of the Democratic Party's paid members and is seen as a key battleground in the August Democratic Party leadership election. Another leadership contender, Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil, is also expected to visit Honam soon. <<> Former leader Chung visited a workshop for elected officials hosted by the Democratic Party's North Jeolla Provincial Party in Jeongeup, North Jeolla, on the same day. Chung resigned from the Supreme Council the previous day, signaling his intent to seek another term, and chose North Jeolla as his first regional schedule after stepping down. North Jeolla is where, in the June 3 local gubernatorial election, pro-Chung candidate Lee Won-taek defeated independent candidate Kim Kwan-young to win. Chung emphasized, "For the first time in the history of local elections, Democratic Party candidates won in all 14 city and county basic local government heads. North Jeolla achieved a sweeping victory." <<> After the event, Chung met with reporters and commented on the timing of officially announcing his candidacy for party leader, saying, "There's a Western proverb: 'Make hay while the sun shines.' Everything has its time. A popular politician must always align with the public's sentiment. I'm carefully considering that aspect." This was interpreted as a statement that he would assess the direction of public opinion. <<> Prime Minister Kim also attended the same event that afternoon and delivered a congratulatory speech. However, their visit times differed, so they did not cross paths. Kim told reporters, "I want to play a role in setting the party's direction to rebuild the Democratic Party into a winning force. I'll have an opportunity to speak about the timing of my candidacy once I've returned to the party." On the 26th, Kim is scheduled to give a lecture in Gwangju to young people about former President Kim Dae-jung, fulfilling two consecutive days of Honam itinerary. <<> Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil, who is currently on a business trip to the U.S., will return on the 27th and visit North Jeolla on the 28th. Song is expected to hold a town hall meeting in Jeonju and announce his stance on running in the party leadership election. While initial speculation suggested Song would only serve as a 'pacemaker' for Prime Minister Kim, recent indications suggest he may run the full race. A Democratic Party source said, "In Honam, the level of support for Song is surprisingly quite high." (더불어민주당 당권 주자로 꼽히는 김민석 국무총리와 정청래 전 민주당 대표가 25일 호남을 찾았다. 호남은 민주당 권리당원 약 3분의 1이 거주하는 지역으로 8월 민주당 당대표 선거에서도 주요 승부처로 꼽힌다. 또 다른 당권 주자인 송영길 민주당 의원도 곧 호남을 찾을 예정이다.)

item.title: When Asked 'Is North Korea the Main Enemy?', Han Duck-soo Says "Anywhere That Threatens South Korea Is the Enemy" (‘北이 주적인가’ 묻자, 한성숙 “한국 위협하는 곳 모두 적”)
item.description:
When Asked 'Is North Korea the Main Enemy?', Han Duck-soo Says "Anywhere That Threatens South Korea Is the Enemy" (‘北이 주적인가’ 묻자, 한성숙 “한국 위협하는 곳 모두 적”)

At the National Assembly confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Duck-soo held on the 25th, questions poured in regarding his views on North Korea and the process of disposing of his real estate. The People Power Party (PPP) probed the diplomatic and security perspectives of Han, a former CEO of Naver who was appointed Minister of SMEs and Startups just a year ago before being nominated as Prime Minister. The Democratic Party of Korea (DP) lauded the sale of three of Han’s four homes ahead of the hearing, stating, "There aren’t many people like this; it deserves high praise." This hearing failed to adopt witnesses and references due to disagreements between the ruling and opposition parties, with the PPP accusing the DP of "undermining the National Assembly’s authority to vet personnel." <<> During the hearing, in response to a question from PPP lawmaker Kim Sun-kyo (Gyeonggi Yeoju-Yangpyeong) asking, "Where is our main enemy?" Han refrained from specifically naming North Korea, saying, "Anywhere that threatens the Republic of Korea is our enemy." When PPP lawmaker Kim Hee-jung (Busan Yeonje) stated, "The North Korean military and regime are our main enemy," Han replied, "I will keep your remarks in mind and listen carefully." When asked whether the Korean War was a "northern invasion" or a "southern invasion," Han initially answered "northern invasion" but corrected it to "southern invasion," adding, "I was nervous." <<> DP lawmaker Park Sun-won (Incheon Bupyeong B) said, "Han is someone who could hold a prime ministerial meeting with North Korea if inter-Korean relations improve. It’s inappropriate to talk about 'main enemies' with such a person." Independent lawmaker Choi Hyuk-jin (Proportional Representation), who applied to rejoin the DP, stated, "The people who armed our cherished children and aimed guns at the National Assembly, or those who tried to assassinate the opposition leader in Gadeokdo, are the Republic of Korea’s true enemies." <<> Lawmakers also continued questioning Han regarding his sale of three of four homes ahead of the confirmation hearing. Han owned a single-family home in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul; an apartment in Jamsil, Songpa-gu, Seoul; an officetel in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul; and a single-family home in Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi Province. He sold the Jamsil apartment in May and recently sold the Yeoksam-dong officetel and Yangpyeong home, becoming a single-homeowner. In response, the opposition remarked, "Homes he didn’t sell as a minister, he offloaded to become prime minister." <<> At the hearing, Han expressed regret, saying, "I apologize for holding multiple homes, which does not align with the public’s expectations." DP lawmaker Park Kyun-taek (Gwangju Gwangsan A) noted, "The properties he owned previously do not appear to have been purchased for speculative purposes." DP lawmaker Park Sun-won added, "The fact that he disposed of most of his real estate in a short period, belatedly joining the policies of President Lee Jae-myung’s administration, deserves high praise. There aren’t many people like this." When PPP lawmakers brought up President Lee Jae-myung’s past comparison of multiple homeowners to "devils" and asked, "So, have you now turned from a devil into a human?" Han replied, "If you put it that way, I seem to have become human." When asked if he would invest in real estate if he returns to civilian life after serving as prime minister, Han said, "No, I won’t." <<> The confirmation hearing on this day proceeded without any witnesses or references, similar to the hearing for Prime Minister Kim Min-seok a year ago. PPP lawmaker Kang Seung-kyu (Chungnam Hongseong-Yesan), the secretary of the special committee on Han’s confirmation, remarked, "Is a hearing without witnesses the new normal? The National Assembly’s power to verify is being undermined." In response, DP lawmaker Kim Han-kyu (Jeju Jeju B), the committee secretary, argued, "We said we could accept most demands except for witnesses related to the Seongnam FC case, which would drag President Lee Jae-myung into a political battleground, but the PPP insisted all requested witnesses must be included." The ruling and opposition parties also clashed over the submission of documents. The PPP claimed that many requested documents from Han had not been submitted, while the DP countered, "Why would we need 30 years of blood donation records or high school grades?" Han’s confirmation hearing is set to continue until the 26th. (25일 열린 한성숙 국무총리 후보자 국회 인사청문회에선 한 후보자의 대북관과 부동산 처분 과정에 대한 질의가 쏟아졌다. 국민의힘은 네이버 대표 출신으로 중소벤처기업부 장관에 취임한 지 1년 만에 총리 후보자에 지명된 한 후보자의 외교·안보관을 파고들었다. 더불어민주당은 한 후보자가 청문회를 앞두고 보유 주택 4채 중 3채를 판 데 대해 “이런 분 잘 없다”며 “높이 평가해야 한다”고 했다. 이번 청문회는 여야 이견으로 증인과 참고인을 채택하지 못했는데, 국민의힘은 “민주당이 국회 인사 검증권을 무력화한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Today's Peace and Prosperity Were Forged by the Sacrifices of Heroes" (李 “지금의 평화·번영, 영웅들 희생으로 일군 것”)
item.description:
Lee: "Today's Peace and Prosperity Were Forged by the Sacrifices of Heroes" (李 “지금의 평화·번영, 영웅들 희생으로 일군 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung attended the 76th anniversary ceremony of the Korean War on the 25th, stating, "The peace and prosperity we enjoy today were never achieved easily," and "They were built upon the noble sacrifices and dedication of heroes who gave everything they had and fought on the battlefields when the nation's fate hung by a thread." (이재명 대통령은 25일 6·25전쟁 76주년 기념식에 참석해 “지금 우리가 누리는 평화와 번영은 결코 거저 얻어진 것이 아니다”라며 “조국의 명운이 백척간두에 섰을 때 자신의 모든 것을 바쳐가며 전장을 누빈 영웅들의 고귀한 희생과 헌신으로 일궈진 것”이라고 했다.)

In his commemorative address at the ceremony held at the Suwon Convention Center, President Lee said, "On behalf of the people, I extend deep respect and gratitude to the veterans of the war," adding these remarks. Approximately 1,000 people, including veterans and their families, military officials, and foreign diplomatic envoys from allied nations, attended the ceremony that day. (이 대통령은 이날 수원컨벤션센터에서 열린 기념식에서 기념사를 통해 “국민을 대표해 참전 유공자 여러분께 깊은 존경과 감사의 말씀을 전한다”면서 이같이 말했다. 이날 기념식에는 유공자와 가족, 군 관계자와 참전국 외교사절 등 1000여명이 참석했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "It is our government's firm principle that special sacrifices and dedication for the nation must be met with special compensation and proper respect," and "We will do our utmost to ensure that the sacrifices of war veterans lead not merely to personal pride but to honorable and stable lives." On this day, the government awarded the Order of Military Merit, Chungmu, to the late veteran Kim Jang-seong, who had achieved distinguished service during the Korean War but fought as an irregular and had long been unrecognized, and the Order of Military Merit, Hwarang, to veteran Lee Young-bok and the late veteran Jeon Ha-jeong. (이 대통령은 “국가를 위한 특별한 희생과 헌신에는 특별한 보상과 마땅한 예우가 뒤따라야 한다는 것이 우리 정부의 확고한 원칙”이라며 “참전 용사의 희생이 개인 자부심에 그치지 않고 명예롭고 안정된 삶으로 이어질 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다. 이날 정부는 6·25 전쟁 때 전과를 올렸지만 비정규군으로 참전해 오랜 기간 공을 인정받지 못했던 고(故) 김장성 용사에게 충무무공훈장을, 이영복 용사와 고 전하정 용사에게 화랑무공훈장을 수여했다.)

Additionally, President Lee stated, "There are those we must never forget—the UN veterans," and "We will expand our veteran diplomacy, including invitations to visit Korea, to ensure that the spirit of solidarity born in the trenches lives on for future generations." (또 이 대통령은 “우리가 결코 잊지 말아야 할 분들이 있다. 바로 유엔 참전 용사들”이라며 “한국 방문 초청을 비롯한 보훈 외교를 더욱 확대해 참호 속에서 싹튼 연대의 정신이 미래 세대에도 살아 숨 쉴 수 있도록 더욱 노력할 것”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee also said, "I will steadfastly protect this great Republic of Korea built by heroes," and "With a strong defense capability, I will safeguard the people and the land and surely create a peaceful Korean Peninsula where there is no need to worry about war or fight." In his commemorative address that day, President Lee did not mention North Korea. (이 대통령은 “영웅들이 만든 이 위대한 대한민국을 흔들림 없이 지켜나가겠다”면서 “강력한 국방력으로 국민과 영토를 지키고 전쟁이 일어날 걱정도 싸울 필요도 없는 평화의 한반도를 반드시 만들어내겠다”고도 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 기념사에서 북한은 언급하지 않았다.)

At the subsequent reception for war veterans, President Lee remarked, "The reason the Republic of Korea has become a globally admired nation today is all thanks to your contributions." He noted that during foreign visits, he receives requests from heads of state for economic cooperation, such as semiconductors, and defense exports, and feels high regard for cultural and political aspects, adding, "This country was nearly destroyed, wasn't it?" "Thanks to those who dedicated their youth and lives in the Korean War, making sacrifices and commitments, the Republic of Korea has grown like this." (이어 열린 참전 유공자 위로연에서 이 대통령은 “대한민국이 오늘날 전 세계적으로 각광받는 나라가 된 것도 다 여러분들의 기여 덕분”이라고 했다. 외국 순방 중 각국 정상으로부터 반도체 등 경제 협력과 방산 수출을 요청받고 문화적·정치적 측면도 높은 평가를 받는 것을 체감한다면서 이 대통령은 “없어질 뻔한 나라 아니겠나” “6·25전쟁에서 청춘과 생명을 바쳐 헌신하고 희생하신 분들 덕분에 대한민국이 이렇게 성장했다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Reverse Discrimination in Yeongnam" "No Monopoly for Gwangju"... Nationwide Conflict Erupts Over Honam Semiconductor Plans (“영남 역차별” “광주 몰빵 안 돼”… 호남 반도체 놓고 전국이 갈등)
item.description:
"Reverse Discrimination in Yeongnam" "No Monopoly for Gwangju"... Nationwide Conflict Erupts Over Honam Semiconductor Plans (“영남 역차별” “광주 몰빵 안 돼”… 호남 반도체 놓고 전국이 갈등)

On the 25th, conservative opposition parties, including the People Power Party, launched criticisms citing "regional discrimination" over Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's unprecedented investment plan in Honam, estimated at over 400 trillion won. The Democratic Party of Korea dismissed this as "groundless claims stirring regional conflict." However, as prospects grew that the semiconductor cluster would be established in the Gwangju-South Jeolla region, areas like Yeongnam, as well as existing project sites in Yongin, Gyeonggi Province, and North Jeolla, have collectively protested, escalating into nationwide regional strife. Business and industry circles express concern that "discussions on a national core strategic project requiring a long-term perspective are being distorted into political 'regional allocation' logic." <<> All 25 members of the People Power Party from Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province held a press conference that day, stating, "The government's role is to create a fair environment so businesses can make the most competitive choices. This Honam semiconductor investment is reverse discrimination against the Yeongnam region," and urged a "full review from scratch." Gumi Mayor Kim Jang-ho also proposed a support plan offering industrial land at 1,000 won per pyeong (3.3 square meters) to attract a semiconductor plant. In a press conference, Mayor Kim said, "For the future of the semiconductor industry and balanced national development, the Gumi National Industrial Complex is the optimal location. At 1,000 won per pyeong, it's cheaper than items sold at Daiso." <<> The 'Honam Semiconductor Cluster' began to take shape in earnest after President Lee Jae-myung remarked in December last year, "Please turn your attention to the southern regions rich in renewable energy for future semiconductor investments." A special semiconductor bill, proposed by Democratic Party lawmaker Jeong Jin-wook, whose constituency is in Gwangju, in January and passed that same month, includes provisions allowing the state to provide up to 100% support for water, electricity, and state-owned land in non-capital areas. This has sparked criticism from the outset that the bill was aimed at attracting investment to the Honam region. <<> This law is set to take effect in August, just before the Democratic Party's national convention. President Lee Jae-myung is expected to announce on the 30th a public-private investment plan for next-generation advanced industries, including artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics, which is believed to encompass the Honam semiconductor investment decision. Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a pro-Lee candidate for party leadership, is reported to attend this event. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk wrote on Facebook, "It's like saying, 'We'll give you semiconductors, so defeat Jeong Cheong-rae.'" This suggests an intention to funnel resources into Honam, a key voting bloc, ahead of the party convention to elect the next leader, thereby rallying votes for pro-Lee candidates. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated, "The decision on the semiconductor plant location should not be used as ammunition for the 'Lee-Cheong' (Lee Jae-myung and Jeong Cheong-rae) convention match." Democratic Party Deputy Floor Leader Ahn Do-geol said at a policy coordination meeting that day, "The People Power Party is turning even voluntary and preemptive investment decisions for the future of businesses into political disputes, indulging in groundless criticism and stoking regional conflict." <<> However, conflicts over the Honam semiconductor project have also emerged within the ruling party. Lawmaker Kim Ui-gyeom, whose constituency is in North Jeolla, stated that day, "To prevent the side effects of a 'Yongin monopoly' from leading to a 'Gwangju monopoly,' it's necessary to distribute the projects." The previous day, nine lawmakers from North Jeolla, including Democratic Party acting leader and floor leader Han Byeong-do and Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young, held a budget policy meeting at the National Assembly and declared, "We will pursue a joint response at the North Jeolla level." In the Chungcheong region, backlash is growing over remarks that if there is a shortage of industrial water in Gwangju and South Jeolla, water would be drawn from Chungcheong. <<> Last year, the ruling party also faced conflict over selecting a location for the 'National AI Computing Center,' a project involving approximately 2.5 trillion won to secure 50,000 GPUs (graphics processing units). At that time, Gwangju, South Jeolla, and North Jeolla competed, with the site ultimately set for Solar City in Haenam, South Jeolla. Local politicians from the failed regions openly voiced opposition. A senior Democratic Party lawmaker noted, "Following the South Jeolla AI Computing Center and Hyundai Motor Group's 9 trillion won investment in an AI and robotics hub in Saemangeum, North Jeolla, funneling astronomical-scale semiconductor facilities into Honam has sparked considerable concern within the party that we could lose public sentiment in Yeongnam by the next general election in two years." (400조원 이상으로 추산되는 삼성전자·SK하이닉스의 사상 최대 규모 호남 반도체 투자 계획을 두고 국민의힘 등 야권이 25일 일제히 “지역 차별”이라며 비판에 나섰다. 더불어민주당은 “근거 없는 주장에 기반한 지역 갈등 조장”이라고 했다. 하지만 반도체 클러스터가 광주·전남권에 구축될 것이란 관측이 나오자 영남권은 물론 기존 사업이 추진되고 있는 경기 용인, 전북 등이 일제히 반발하는 등 전국적 지역 갈등으로 번지는 양상이다. 재계와 산업계에선 “장기적인 안목으로 접근해야 할 국가 핵심 전략 사업 논의가 정치권의 ‘지역 배분’ 논리로 변질되는 것 아니냐”는 우려가 나온다.)

item.title: Government Unveils Logo for 150th Anniversary of Baekbeom Kim Koo’s Birth: “My Wish, A Culture of Peace” (정부, 백범 김구 탄생 150주년 기념 로고 제정… “나의 소원, 평화의 문화”)
item.description:
Government Unveils Logo for 150th Anniversary of Baekbeom Kim Koo’s Birth: “My Wish, A Culture of Peace” (정부, 백범 김구 탄생 150주년 기념 로고 제정… “나의 소원, 평화의 문화”)

The government unveiled a logo on the 26th to be used in domestic and international commemorative projects marking the 150th anniversary of the birth of Baekbeom Kim Koo (1876-1949). Born on August 29, 1876, Kim Koo’s legacy has been recognized by UNESCO, which designated 2026 as the “Year of Commemoration for the 150th Anniversary of Kim Koo’s Birth.” (정부가 백범 김구(1876~1949) 선생의 탄생 150주년을 기념해 국내외 기념 사업에 사용할 로고를 26일 공개했다. 김구 선생은 1876년 8월 29일 태어났고, 지난해 유네스코(UNESCO·유엔교육과학문화기구)는 2026년을 ‘김구 탄생 150주년 기념해’로 지정했다.)

The logo, released on this day by the Office for Government Policy Coordination’s Project Group for the 80th Anniversary of Liberation, features a portrait of Kim Koo on the left, with the phrases “Kim Koo 150” and “My Wish, A Culture of Peace” on the right. (국무조정실 광복 80년 기념사업추진단이 이날 공개한 로고는 김구 선생의 초상을 왼쪽에 두고 오른쪽에 ‘김구 150’ ‘나의 소원, 평화의 문화’라고 적혀 있다.)

The project group explained, “Based on Kim Koo’s widely known portrait, we expressed both his gentleness and solemnity.” They added, “Through the Korean spelling ‘김구,’ we aimed to clearly convey the significance of the commemorative year in our script. We varied the width of each letter to create a visual rhythm, and by using a stylized, traditional font (panbonche), we considered both historical weight and modern usability.” They further noted, “The color scheme adopts ‘UNESCO Blue’ as the base color, taking into account harmony and usability when paired with the UNESCO logo.” (추진단은 “김구 선생의 널리 알려진 초상을 바탕으로 온화함과 진중함이 함께 드러나도록 표현했다”고 설명했다. 이어 “한글 ‘김구’를 통해 기념해의 의미를 우리 문자로 분명하게 전달하도록 했고, 각 글자마다 폭에 차이를 둬 시각적 리듬감을 부여했으며, 판본체를 통해 역사적 무게감과 현대적 활용성을 함께 고려했다”고 했다. “색상은 ‘유네스코 블루’를 기본색으로 적용했으며, 유네스코 로고와 함께 사용할 때의 조화와 활용성을 고려했다”고도 부연했다.)

The project group stated that “My Wish, A Culture of Peace” is based on Kim Koo’s philosophy, embodying the values of culture and peace that he pursued. (추진단은 ‘나의 소원, 평화와 문화’는 김구 선생의 사상을 바탕으로, 김구 선생이 추구한 문화와 평화의 가치를 담은 것이라고 밝혔다.)

They also mentioned developing an English version of the logo for use in international events and overseas promotional materials, as well as black-and-white versions to allow for flexible use depending on the medium and purpose. (추진단은 또 영문 로고를 함께 개발해, 국제 행사와 해외 홍보물에서도 활용할 수 있게 했고, 검은색·흰색으로 된 로고도 개발해 매체와 목적에 따라 달리 사용할 수 있게 했다고 설명했다.)

The project group announced that the logo will be used in major commemorative projects, including domestic and international academic conferences, cultural week programs, and memorial ceremonies. The government is undertaking various initiatives such as domestic and international academic conferences to commemorate Kim Koo’s birth, exhibitions of the Baekbeom Ilji (Kim Koo’s autobiography) and original materials, symposiums on Kim Koo’s inter-Korean negotiations, cultural weeks, commemorative performances, overseas media production projects, international commemorative performances and special exhibitions, issuance of commemorative medals and stamps, distribution of commemorative games, youth field trips to historical sites, special lectures, and the renovation of Gyeonggyojang, Kim Koo’s former residence. (추진단은 로고를 국내외 학술 대회와 문화 주간 운영, 기념식 등 주요 기념 사업에서 활용할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 정부는 김구 탄생 기념 국내·국제 학술 대회, 백범일지 및 원본 자료 전시, 김구 선생의 남북 협상에 관한 심포지엄, 문화 주간, 기념 공연, 해외 미디어 제작 프로젝트, 해외 기념 공연 및 특별 전시, 기념 메달·우표 발행, 기념 게임 배포, 청소년 사적지 답사, 특별 강연, 김구 선생의 사저였던 경교장 정비 등의 사업을 진행하고 있다.)

item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo: "President Lee's Abuse of Power in Honam Semiconductor Investment" — Yun Hee-sook: "Did You Ask the Shareholders?" (안철수 “호남 반도체 투자, 李대통령의 직권남용” 윤희숙 “주주들에겐 물어봤나”)
item.description:
Ahn Cheol-soo: "President Lee's Abuse of Power in Honam Semiconductor Investment" — Yun Hee-sook: "Did You Ask the Shareholders?" (안철수 “호남 반도체 투자, 李대통령의 직권남용” 윤희숙 “주주들에겐 물어봤나”)

People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo criticized the presidential office-led 400 trillion won investment by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in Honam on the 26th, stating, "It is a clear abuse of power for the presidential office to spearhead demands for private corporate funds—not government finances—without any legal basis, targeting a specific region for an astronomical amount exceeding half of South Korea's annual budget." (안철수 국민의힘 의원은 26일 청와대가 주도하는 삼성전자·SK하이닉스의 400조원대 호남 반도체 투자에 대해 “대한민국 1년 치 예산의 절반이 넘는 천문학적인 금액을, 그 어떤 법적 근거도 없이, 정부 재정도 아닌 민간 기업의 자본으로, 청와대가 주도하여, 특정 지역을 점찍어 투자를 요구하는 것은 명백한 직권 남용”이라고 비판했다.)

In a Facebook post that morning, Ahn said of the Honam semiconductor investment, "With the president and the presidential office taking the lead, dragging them by the collar, and the Democratic Party prodding from behind, a massive 400 trillion won semiconductor infrastructure has suddenly fallen into one region." (안 의원은 이날 아침 페이스북에 글을 올려 호남 반도체 투자에 대해 “대통령과 청와대가 전면에 나서서 멱살 잡고 끌고, 민주당이 뒤에서 부추기니, 400조원에 달하는 초대형 반도체 인프라가 한 지역에 뚝딱 떨어지는 형국”이라고 했다.)

He asked, "In a free democratic country like South Korea, does the president have the authority to order a private company—not a state-run enterprise—to invest hundreds of trillions of won in a specific region? Absolutely not," he asserted. (그는 “도대체가 자유 민주주의 국가인 대한민국에서, 대통령에게 공기업도 아닌 사기업에 수백조 원의 투자를 특정 지역에 하라고 하명할 수 있는 권한이 있느냐”며 “단연코 없다”고 했다.)

He pointed out, "Even government-led SOC (social overhead capital) projects using the national budget must undergo rigorous preliminary feasibility studies and economic evaluations if they exceed 100 billion won. Local government competitive projects also require nationwide applications and multiple stages of review to be selected." (그러면서 “정부 예산으로 정부가 주도하는 SOC(사회간접자본) 사업마저도 1000억원이 넘으면 까다로운 예비 타당성 조사와 경제성 평가를 거쳐야 한다. 지자체 공모 사업 또한 전국적으로 지원서를 받아 수 단계의 심사를 통과해야만 선정되는 법”이라고 지적했다.)

Recalling the past abuse of power trial, Ahn noted, "During that trial, the president was found guilty merely for proposing that large corporations make donations to a specific foundation. Coincidentally, those who suffered then are the current chairmen of Samsung and SK Hynix." He added, "It seems they have forgotten that President Lee and the Democratic Party mocked and criticized this as 'collusion between politics and business' at the time." (안 의원은 “과거 국정농단 재판 당시, 대통령이 대기업에 특정 재단 출연금을 제안한 사실 만으로도 유죄 판결이 내려졌다”고 상기하면서 “공교롭게도 그때 고초를 겪었던 분들이 바로 삼전닉스의 현 회장들”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “당시 이 대통령과 민주당은 이를 ‘정경유착’이라며 조소하고, 비난했음을 잊은 듯하다”고 꼬집었다.)

"Under a free market economy, corporate investments must be thoroughly decided by the companies themselves," Ahn said. "The current behavior of President Lee and Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom is nothing short of flagrant abuse of power. They should remember that every word and action will eventually lead to legal punishment." (안 의원은 “자유 시장 경제 체제에서 기업의 투자는 철저히 기업 스스로가 판단해야 한다”며 “지금 이 대통령과 (김용범) 정책실장의 행태는 직권 남용 현행범들의 행태라 해도 과언이 아니다. 앞으로의 언행 하나하나가 결국 법적 단죄로 되돌아올 것임을 명심하기 바란다”고 했다.)

Former People Power Party lawmaker Yun Hee-sook also posted on Facebook that morning, saying, "If a factory is built not where the company found the best location after years of review, but where the government twists its arm to force it, the competitiveness of the semiconductor industry will be damaged." She added, "A government that takes such sharp-edged international competition so lightly is now beyond pathetic—it's scary." (윤희숙 전 국민의힘 의원도 이날 아침 페이스북에 글을 올려 “기업이 몇 년간의 검토 끝에 찾아낸 입지가 아니라, 정부가 팔을 비틀어 강요한 곳에 공장을 지으면, 반도체 산업 경쟁력이 훼손될 것”이라며 “칼날 같은 국제 경쟁을 이렇게 만만하게 여기는 정부가 이젠 한심한 걸 넘어 두렵다”고 했다.)

Yun further stated, "Moreover, Honam has unfavorable conditions for securing power, water, and talent, making it difficult to estimate how much corporate investment and fiscal spending would increase, with figures swinging between 500 trillion and 1,000 trillion won. If built in a location with better conditions, the burden on both the company and government would be drastically reduced, yet the Lee Jae-myung government, deaf to reason, only chants 'all-in on Honam.'" (윤 전 의원은 “게다가 전력, 용수, 인재 확보 입지 요건이 불리한 호남이니, 기업 투자와 재정 지출이 얼마나 늘어야 할지 추산도 어려워 500조~1000조까지 널뛰고 있다”며 “입지 요건이 좋은 곳에 만든다면 기업과 정부가 부담해야 할 액수가 대폭 줄어들 텐데도 이재명 정부는 마이동풍으로 ‘호남 몰빵’만 외친다”고 했다.)

Yun argued, "Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix must choose the best location to maximize semiconductor yield and business viability, and they must get shareholder approval that their decision is the best for the company, not one made under coercion from the administration." (윤 전 의원은 “삼성전자와 하이닉스는 반도체 수율과 사업성을 높이기에 가장 좋은 입지를 정하고, 정권의 협박에 굴복한 결정이 아니라 기업을 위해 최선의 결정(을 한 것)임을 주주들에게 승인받아야 한다”고 주장했다.)

She said, "What era is this, that decisions about the future of the nation and industry are dictated in the presidential office's backroom? President Lee is not the mayor of Gwangju." <<>> (그는 “시대가 어느 시댄데 청와대 밀실에서 국가와 산업의 미래가 달린 결정을 윽박질러 정하느냐”며 “이 대통령은 광주시장이 아니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong Un Observes Tests of New Multiple Rocket Launchers and Missiles for Striking South Korea on June 25, Saying "I Will Keep the Enemy in a State of Fear" (김정은, 6·25에 한국 타격용 신형 방사포·미사일 시험 참관 … “적들이 두려움 속에 있게 하겠다”)
item.description:
Kim Jong Un Observes Tests of New Multiple Rocket Launchers and Missiles for Striking South Korea on June 25, Saying "I Will Keep the Enemy in a State of Fear" (김정은, 6·25에 한국 타격용 신형 방사포·미사일 시험 참관 … “적들이 두려움 속에 있게 하겠다”)

North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un observed test launches of new multiple rocket launchers and missiles designed to strike South Korea on the 25th, marking the 76th anniversary of North Korea's invasion of the South. Kim threatened to "further enhance the destructive attack posture" and "keep the enemy in constant anxiety and fear." (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 북한의 남침 76년째가 되는 지난 25일 한국을 타격하기 위한 신형 방사포와 미사일 시험 발사를 참관했다. 김정은은 “파괴적 공격 태세를 더욱 높일 것”이라며 “적들이 상시 불안과 두려움 속에 있게 하겠다”고 위협했다.)

North Korea's Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 26th that Kim had observed "important weapons tests organized by defense science research institutes the previous day, in accordance with the plan for modernizing artillery and missile forces to achieve the five-year goals for national defense development." (북한 조선중앙통신은 26일 김정은이 전날 “국방 발전 5개년 목표 수행을 위한 포 및 미사일 무력 현대화 사업 계획에 따라, 국방 과학 연구 기관들에서 조직한 중요 무기 시험을 참관”했다고 보도했다.)

The agency stated that "the tests analyzed and evaluated the combat characteristics of the upgraded 240mm 24-barrel multiple rocket launcher system, the power of the special mission warhead of a tactical ballistic missile, and the accuracy of extended-range shells for 155mm self-propelled howitzers and guns." (통신은 “시험에서는 갱신형(개량형) 240㎜ 24관식 방사포 무기 체계의 전투적 특성과 전술 탄도 미사일의 특수 사명(특수 목적) 전투부 위력, 155㎜ 자행(자주식) 평·곡사포 사거리 연장탄의 명중 정확성을 분석 평가”했다고 밝혔다.)

Regarding the "upgraded 240mm 24-barrel multiple rocket launcher system," the agency introduced it as "an improved corps-level firepower system with a range increased to 90 km, where all elements of the fire control system are automated and a autonomous precision guidance system has been introduced." (통신은 ‘갱신형 240㎜ 24관식 방사포 무기 체계’에 관해 “화력 복무 체계의 모든 요소들이 자동화되고, 자치 정밀 유도 체계가 도입”됐다며 “사거리는 90㎞로 증가된 개량형 군단급 화력 체계”라고 소개했다.)

The "special mission warhead of the tactical ballistic missile" is said to be "aimed at the fatal destruction of key targets, including enemy airfields, ports, and power facilities." (‘전술 탄도미사일 특수 사명 전투부’는 “적의 비행장, 항구, 전력 시설을 비롯한 중요 표적들의 치명적인 파괴를 목적”으로 한다고 했다.)

The extended-range 155mm self-propelled howitzer and gun shells also hold "significant military importance," with their range stated to be 65 km. (155㎜ 자행 평·곡사포 사거리 연장탄도 “중대한 군사적 의의를 띤다”며 사거리는 65㎞라고 밝혔다.)

The distance from the Military Demarcation Line to central Seoul is approximately 50 km. A range of 65 km reaches areas like Bundang-gu in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, Dongtan New Town in Hwaseong, and Osan, while 90 km extends to Pyeongtaek in Gyeonggi Province and Cheonan in South Chungcheong Province. (군사분계선에서 서울 중심부까지 거리는 약 50㎞다. 65㎞는 경기 성남시 분당구나 화성시 동탄신도시, 오산시 등에, 90㎞는 경기 평택시와 충남 천안시 등에 이른다.)

The agency reported that Kim expressed "great satisfaction" with the test results and said he was "pleased to be able to demonstrate the new stage of national defense development introduced at the 9th Central Committee's 2nd Plenary Session (held on the 20th-22nd)." At the session, Kim criticized South Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines and the South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises for "extremely worsening the situation on the Korean Peninsula," and stated he would "unwaveringly and powerfully push forward the work to further increase powerful national defense assets, aiming for a level that can overwhelm the world." (통신은 김정은이 시험 결과에 ‘대만족’을 표시했다며 “(지난 20~22일 열린) 당 중앙위원회 9기 2차 전원회의에서 소개한 국방 발전의 새로운 경지를 보여줄 수 있게 된 것을 기쁘게 생각한다”고 말했다고 전했다. 회의에서 김정은은 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함(원잠) 보유 추진과 한·미 군사 연습이 “조선반도(한반도) 정세를 극도로 악화시키고 있다”고 비난하면서 “위력한 국방 자산들을 더욱 늘려 나가기 위한 사업을 멈춤 없이, 세계를 압도할 수 있는 수준을 목표로 해 강력히 실행해 나가겠다”고 했었다.)

The agency quoted Kim as saying, "The tests conducted today of the division and corps firepower systems serve as an opportunity to prove and confirm the major technological advancements achieved in realizing our party's policy for military construction regarding changes in the firepower posture at the southern border (the armistice line) and the three principles of automation, long-range capability, and ultra-precision." (통신은 김정은이 “오늘 진행한 사단·군단 화력 체계들의 시험은 남부 국경(휴전선)의 화력 태세 변화에 관한 우리 당의 무력 건설 방침과 자동화, 장거리화, 초정밀화의 3대 원칙 실현에서 이룩한 커다란 기술적 진보를 증명하고 확신할 수 있는 계기”라고 했다고 전했다.)

Kim further emphasized, "Today's international situation, where national sovereignty and survival itself can only be guaranteed through absolute military superiority, makes any rhetorical explanation unnecessary as to why the work of strengthening defense capabilities is an essential and top-priority national strategic task." (김정은은 이어서 “철저한 힘의 우위로써만 국권을 지키고 생존 그 자체를 보장할 수 있는 오늘의 국제 형세는 방위력 강화 사업이 왜 필수불가결한 국가적 제1의 전략적인 사업으로 되는가에 대한 그 어떤 수사적 설명도 구태여 보충할 필요가 없게 하고 있다”고 강조했다.)

He added, "Our party's self-defense policy is not merely about enhancing defensive functions based on defensive means, but a policy of raising a fatal and destructive attack posture to make it impossible for any enemy to counter us. This is what we call the 'defensive concept' in military construction and the practice of military action." (또 “우리 당의 자위적 방위 정책은 방어적 수단들에 의거하는 단순한 방어적 기능의 제고가 아니라, 치명적이고 파괴적인 공격 태세를 높여 대적할 적수가 없게 만드는 정책”이라며 “이것이 우리가 말하는 군 건설과 군사 행동 실천에서의 ‘방어적 개념’”이라고 했다.)

The agency reported Kim as saying, "Keeping the enemy in constant anxiety and fear is itself a crucial aspect of exercising war deterrence," and "I will make the enemy aware that all of our armed forces' long-range strike means will be completely replaced and equipped with upgraded versions within the shortest possible timeframe." <<>> (김정은은 “적들이 상시 불안과 두려움 속에 있게 하는 것 그 자체가 전쟁 억제력 행사의 중요한 결행 일면이 된다”며 “가급적 최단기간 내에 우리 무력의 장거리 타격 수단들이 갱신형으로 전부 교체 장비된 것을 적들이 알게 만들 것”이라고 했다고 통신은 전했다.)

item.title: Koh Min-jeong: Jeong Cheong-rae Visiting Moon? "When Intent is Visible, There's No Emotion" (고민정, 文 찾아간 정청래에 “의도 읽히면 감동 없어”)
item.description:
Koh Min-jeong: Jeong Cheong-rae Visiting Moon? "When Intent is Visible, There's No Emotion" (고민정, 文 찾아간 정청래에 “의도 읽히면 감동 없어”)

Koh Min-jeong, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, expressed dissatisfaction with former lawmaker Jeong Cheong-rae on the 26th, stating that Jeong is contemplating running in the August party convention's leadership election as he seeks a second term. She criticized Jeong's visit to former President Moon Jae-in the previous day, saying, "When the intent is visible, there's no emotion." <<> On the 26th morning, appearing on YTN Radio's 'Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang,' Koh first explained her decision to run in the general election despite serving in the Blue House during the Moon Jae-in administration: "After all the effort to make a president, if we can't create the situation and atmosphere for that president to work, one can't help but wonder why we seized power." She added, "To run state affairs, legislation must support it, and since that wasn't happening, how frustrated must I have been to come all the way to the National Assembly?" <<> Koh continued, "In the National Assembly, we (the Democratic Party) are in such a favorable environment, and President Lee Jae-myung is more driven than anyone, yet we're not keeping up the legislative pace," noting, "That frustration is common among most party lawmakers. It's not a factional issue." <<> Koh evaluated President Lee Jae-myung as having "done well," but expressed "considerable dissatisfaction" with former lawmaker Jeong Cheong-rae. She also mentioned that she is "considering" running for the party convention. <<> Koh said, "Until now, I haven't been in the party leadership, so I've never voiced such complaints, but how long can this go on?" <<> Koh argued, "Pro-Lee and pro-Moon groups are meaningless. You can only be chosen by the people if you become pro-public." <<> Regarding Jeong's emphasis on his pro-Roh and pro-Moon background, Koh claimed, "It's emphasized because he hopes to be perceived that way." She added, "For instance, does former President Moon constantly say, 'I am Roh Moo-hyun's person'? Everyone already knows that, so he doesn't bother." She continued, "Depending on the times, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung emerge to continue the party's legitimacy. Does having been in a certain faction make someone the legitimate heir? Would those in heaven acknowledge such things?" <<> On Jeong's visit to former President Moon as his first schedule after stepping down as party leader, Koh said, "If Moon had said 'don't come,' wouldn't he have not gone? It's unavoidable." She added, "In any case, when the intent is visible, there's no emotion. Most citizens and party members would see it similarly to me." <<> When asked what advice she would have given to former President Moon if she had known about Jeong's meeting request in advance, Koh said she would have told him "not to meet." She explained, "In such a fiercely competitive party leadership race, if you meet some and not others, it inevitably sparks controversy over how many were met, whether meals or drinks were shared, and what was discussed. If that's intentionally done for politics, fine, but otherwise, there's no reason to create misunderstandings." (고민정 더불어민주당 의원이 26일 정청래 전 대표에게 불만이 많았다며, 정 전 대표가 재선에 도전하는 8월 전당대회에서 민주당 지도부 선거에 출마를 고민하고 있다고 밝혔다. 정 전 대표가 전날 문재인 전 대통령을 찾아간 것에 대해서는 “의도가 읽히면 감동은 없다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: Han Byeong-do Says "Criminal Procedure Act Revision to Begin Immediately After Assembly Formation"... Steps Toward Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers (한병도 “원 구성 직후 형소법 개정 돌입”...보완수사권 폐지 수순)
item.description:
Han Byeong-do Says "Criminal Procedure Act Revision to Begin Immediately After Assembly Formation"... Steps Toward Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers (한병도 “원 구성 직후 형소법 개정 돌입”...보완수사권 폐지 수순)

Han Byeong-do, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea and floor leader, stated on the 26th regarding the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers: "The Democratic Party will begin reviewing amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act. And as soon as the second-half assembly formation is completed, we will immediately launch the revision process." This came right after Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said the previous day, "The government has finalized its basic position to abolish supplementary investigation powers," drawing a prompt response from the Democratic Party. (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지와 관련해 “민주당은 형사소송법 개정 내용 검토에 착수하겠다. 그리고 하반기 원 구성이 마무리되는 즉시 개정 절차에 곧바로 돌입하겠다”고 26일 밝혔다. 전날 김민석 국무총리가 “보완수사권 폐지를 정부 기본 입장으로 최종 정리했다”고 하자마자 민주당이 호응한 것이다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting on the same day, Acting Leader Han said, "We will ensure that reforms settle into a better judicial system that protects the ordinary lives of the people, concluding it with deliberation and responsible legislation." (한 직무대행은 이날 최고위원회의에서 “개혁이 국민의 평범한 일상을 지키는 더 나은 사법 시스템으로 안착하도록 숙의와 책임 있는 입법으로 마무리하겠다”면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

Acting Leader Han stated, "The Democratic Party’s will for prosecution reform has never stopped for a single moment," adding, "The separation of investigation and prosecution is a task of the times to prevent abuse of prosecutorial power and to provide stronger protection for the people’s fundamental rights." He continued, "With the dissolution of the prosecution service and the launch of the Public Prosecution Service and the Major Crimes Investigation Office approaching in October this year, revision of the Criminal Procedure Act—the final piece of prosecution reform—is an urgent task. We will swiftly and unwaveringly fulfill our promise to the people regarding prosecution reform." <<> Regarding National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik’s demand that the People Power Party submit its list of standing committee members by noon on the 26th, Acting Leader Han said, "If the People Power Party does not submit the list by noon today, the Democratic Party will unilaterally proceed with the formation of the standing committees in accordance with the National Assembly Act." He noted, "The Democratic Party has held ten rounds of negotiations on the assembly formation," adding, "We have endured enough in the name of respect and cooperation." He further stated, "Making the National Assembly function is both the ruling party’s responsibility and its duty to the people. The Democratic Party will fulfill that duty today." (한 직무대행은 “민주당의 검찰개혁 의지는 단 한 번도 멈춘 적이 없다”면서 “수사와 기소의 분리는 검찰권 남용을 막고 국민의 기본권을 더 두텁게 보호하기 위한 시대적 과제”라고 했다. 이어 “검찰청 폐지와 공소청, 중수청 출범이 올해 10월로 다가온 만큼 검찰개혁의 마지막 단추인 형사소송법 개정은 초읽기 과제”라면서 “검찰개혁이라는 국민과의 약속을 흔들림 없이 신속하게 마무리하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Visits Wonsan-Kalma Zone, Orders Modernization of North Korea’s Most Dilapidated Railway Stations (원산갈마지구 찾은 김정은, 최악 낙후 北 철도역 현대화 지시)
item.description:
Kim Jong-un Visits Wonsan-Kalma Zone, Orders Modernization of North Korea’s Most Dilapidated Railway Stations (원산갈마지구 찾은 김정은, 최악 낙후 北 철도역 현대화 지시)

North Korean leader Kim Jong-un visited the Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Zone, a North Korean-style integrated resort in Kangwon Province, inspecting a newly built railway station and outlining plans to modernize major railway stations across the country. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 북한판 복합 리조트인 강원도 원산·갈마해안관광지구를 찾아 새로 지은 철도역을 시찰하고 전국 주요 철도역을 현대화하겠다는 구상을 밝혔다.)

North Korea’s state-run Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 26th that Kim Jong-un “provided on-site guidance on the new projects in the Wonsan-Kalma District” on the 24th. (북한 조선중앙통신은 26일 김정은이 지난 24일 “원산갈마지구 신설 대상들을 현지 지도하셨다”고 보도했다.)

According to KCNA, Kim inspected the newly constructed Kalma Tourist Railway Station, examining construction progress and operational readiness. He praised the builders, saying, “It seems like only yesterday that we decided to set the site close to the tourist zone to ensure convenience for visiting passengers, and in just one year, a modern railway station has risen up vigorously.” He added, “The builders have worked hard.” (통신에 따르면, 김정은은 새로 건설한 갈마관광철도역을 돌아보고 시공과 운영 준비 상황을 살폈다. 그러면서 “관광지구를 찾는 여객들의 편리를 도모할 수 있도록 관광지구 가까이에 터전을 잡아준 지가 엊그제 같은데, 불과 1년 새에 현대적인 철도역이 일떠섰다(기운차게 일어섰다)”며 “건설자들이 수고가 많았다”고 치하했다.)

Kim stated, “All elements of the railway station are harmoniously arranged in line with our Party’s architectural aesthetic philosophy, practical layout principles, and the demands of the times,” noting that “this advancement in railway station construction will serve as an important opportunity to establish standards for renovating local railway stations and to change perceptions.” (김정은은 “철도역의 모든 요소가 우리 당의 건축 미학 사상과 실용적 배치 원칙, 시대적 요구에 맞게 조화롭게 구성됐다”며 “철도역 건설에서 한 단계 진보한 것이 지방 철도역 개건에 관한 기준을 확립하고 인식을 개변하는 중요한 계기가 될 것”이라고 했다.)

KCNA reported that Kim “expressed the plan to modernize railway stations in county seats nationwide based on the achievements and experience gained in railway station construction.” It added that Kim instructed, “Prioritize scientific designs that take into account the characteristics and functional needs of each region, including passenger and cargo throughput capacity, and review the corresponding budget accordingly.” KCNA also said Kim presented “a series of tasks, including measures to ensure the supply of various printing equipment and facilities needed for railway station management, and the specialization of tourist train formation and operation.” (통신은 김정은이 “철도역 건설에서 이룩한 성과와 경험에 토대를 두고, 전국의 도소재지 철도역들을 현대적으로 일신시키실 구상을 피력하셨다”고 전했다. 그러면서 김정은이 “여객 및 화물 통과 능력을 비롯한 해당 지역의 특성과 기능적 요구를 타산한 과학적인 설계를 선행시키고, 그에 따르는 예산을 심의해 보라”고 지시했다고 전했다. 김정은이 “철도역 경영 관리에 필요한 여러 용도의 윤전기재들과 설비들을 보장해 주기 위한 대책을 세우는 문제, 관광 열차의 편성과 운영을 전문화하는 문제 등 일련의 과업”을 제시했다고도 했다.)

North Korea’s railway is a critical means of transport, handling about 90% of freight and 60% of passenger transport, but it is extremely dilapidated. Almost none of the tracks are double-tracked, and severe aging means most lines operate at speeds of around 20 km/h. (북한의 철도는 북한에서 화물 운송의 90%, 여객 운송의 60%가량을 담당하는 중요 교통 수단이지만, 극도로 낙후돼 있다. 거의 전부가 복선화돼 있지 않고, 노후화가 심각해 대다수 노선이 시속 20㎞ 정도로 운행된다.)

item.title: Park Sun-won, Running for Supreme Council Member, Says "Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil's Alliance Is a Natural Flow" (與 최고위원 출마한 박선원 “김민석·송영길 연합은 자연스러운 흐름”)
item.description:
Park Sun-won, Running for Supreme Council Member, Says "Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil's Alliance Is a Natural Flow" (與 최고위원 출마한 박선원 “김민석·송영길 연합은 자연스러운 흐름”)

Lawmaker Park Sun-won, who announced his candidacy for the Supreme Council election at the Democratic Party of Korea's national convention in August, stated that the alliance between Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former leader Song Young-gil to counter former leader Jeong Cheong-rae in the party leadership election is a "natural flow." (8월 더불어민주당 전당대회에서 최고위원 선거에 출마하겠다고 밝힌 박선원 의원은 당대표 선거에서 정청래 전 대표에 대항해 김민석 국무총리와 송영길 전 대표가 연대하는 것이 “자연스러운 흐름”이라고 말했다.)

In an interview with KBS Radio's "Emergency Current Affairs" on the morning of the 26th, Park commented on the party leadership election, saying, "Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae stepping down as party leader is seen as a sign that he will run in the upcoming party leadership primary. Prime Minister Kim Min-seok also seems likely to run, and former leader Song Young-gil has said he will run if Jeong enters the race, so the three of them running as candidates for party leader is almost set." (박 의원은 26일 오전 KBS라디오 ‘전격시사’와 인터뷰에서 당대표 선거에 대해 “(정청래 전 대표가) 당대표를 관둔 것은 앞으로 당대표 경선에 나오겠다는 뜻으로 받아들여지고 있고, 김민석 총리도 나올 것 같고, 송영길 전 대표는 정 전 대표가 나오면 나온다고 했기 때문에, 세 분이 당대표 후보로 나오는 것은 거의 굳어져 가고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding media reports that no candidate may secure a majority in the party leadership election, leading to a runoff, Park said, "A runoff is stipulated in the party constitution and rules. If the three candidates split the vote equally, each would get 33%, so a runoff is possible. The media isn't getting ahead of themselves at all." (박 의원은 당대표 선거에서 누구도 과반을 득표하지 못해 결선 투표로 갈 가능성이 언론을 통해 나오는 데 대해 “(결선 투표는) 당헌당규에 들어 있는 것이고, (세 후보가 득표율을) 똑같이 나눠 간다면 33%씩이기 때문에 결선 투표로 갈 수 있다”며 “언론이 앞서가는 것이 전혀 아니다”라고 했다.)

On the rumored Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil alliance, Park said, "Rather than continuing to show discomfort with the president, these two people—who seem to think it's better to establish a system where they can work together with the president—forming an alliance or coalition is not so much factional politics but a natural flow." (김민석·송영길 연합설에 대해서는 “대통령에 대해 계속 불편한 입장을 보였던 것보다는, (대통령과) 함께 일할 수 있는 체제를 갖추는 것이 낫겠다고 생각하는 두 사람이 연합, 연대하는 것은 계파 정치라기보다는 자연스러운 흐름”이라고 했다.)

Park further argued, "The national convention should be a festival for party members and a venue for policy competition. But there's a tendency to divide into factions and drag things toward factional politics, which should not happen. Debating in terms of 'we must go this way to seize party power' or 'this faction is bigger or smaller' is not desirable." (박 의원은 그러면서 “전당대회가 당원의 축제의 장, 정책 경쟁의 장이 돼야 하는데, 파벌 가르기, 계파 정치로 끌고 가려고 하는 경향이 있는데, 그래서는 안 된다”며 “당권을 잡기 위해 이쪽으로 가야 한다, 저쪽 파가 세력이 크다, 작다는 식으로 논쟁하는 것은 바람직하지 않다”고 주장했다.)

Regarding YouTuber Kim Eo-jun's analysis that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating decline indicates a 'core support base is defecting,' Park criticized, "If there's an underlying implication that we need to do something because the support base is wavering, or that we should repeatedly push a so-called 'hardline' stance for the core support base, that's strange." (유튜버 김어준씨가 이재명 대통령의 지지율 하락에 대해 ‘코어 지지층이 이탈하고 있다’고 분석한 데 대해서는 “지지층이 흔들리니 무엇을 해야 한다, 아니면 핵심 지지층을 위해서 소위 말하는 ‘강성’의 입장을 반복적으로 내야 한다는 (식으로) 복선이 있다고 하면 그것은 이상하다”고 비판했다.)

The previous day, Prime Minister Kim announced that the government had decided to fully abolish prosecutors' complementary investigative powers without exception. Former leader Jeong responded on Facebook, saying, "The government has shifted the burden to the National Assembly. Isn't this a delaying tactic?" On this, Park said, "I'm not sure how a person who was party leader just the day before yesterday appears to the public when making such remarks." Regarding Jeong's assertion that related legislation should be completed by July 17, Park questioned, "If it's just suggesting a direction to move quickly, there's no problem. But if it's presented as a mandatory deadline or a last line of defense, is that realistic?" (전날 김 총리는 정부가 검사의 보완 수사권을 예외 없이 완전히 폐지하는 것을 입장으로 정했다고 발표했고, 정 전 대표는 페이스북을 통해 ‘정부가 국회로 떠넘겼다. 시간 끌기 작전 아니냐’고 했다. 이에 대해 박 의원은 “그저께까지 당대표를 했던 분이 그렇게 말씀하시는 것이 국민 눈에 어떻게 비칠지 잘 모르겠다”고 했다. 정 전 대표가 7월 17일 전에 관련 입법을 마치자고 주장한 데 대해서는 “신속하게 해야 한다는 방향을 제시한 것이라면 문제가 없지만, 마치 반드시 해야 하는 데드라인, 마지노선이라고 한다면 그게 현실성이 있느냐”고 했다.)

Park declared his candidacy for the Supreme Council election on the 24th. Regarding this, he said, "After the local elections, there was debate over which party won and who lost, but regardless of victory or defeat, the people are not giving our government generous evaluations." He added, "If our Democratic Party does not show greater focus, what kind of assessments and criticism will we face? I made the decision to run with a humble heart, determined to work hard from now on." (박 의원은 지난 24일 최고위원 선거 출마를 선언했다. 이와 관련해 그는 “지방선거 이후 어느 당이 승리했느냐, 누가 패배했느냐는 논쟁이 있었는데, 승패를 떠나서 국민들이 우리 정부를 후하게 평가하지 않는다는 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “우리 민주당이 더욱 집중력을 발휘하지 않는다면 어떤 평가와 비판을 받게 될 것인가, 지금부터 열심히 일해야겠다는 경건한 마음속에서 출마를 결심했다”고 말했다.)
